# NoGlitchBlocks

**Category:** World  
**Aliases:** NoGlitchBlocks

## What it does

Prevents client-side ghost blocks

Description basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/NoGlitchBlocks.html). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
